EC1: Clinically significant new illness within 1 month before randomization that may affect the participant's ability to fulfill the study requirements [OR] or significantly confound the assessments
EC2: Participants who cannot swallow [AND] investigational products
EC3: Participants with T2DM who have hypoglycemia unawareness
EC6: Mitral [OR] or aortic valve stenosis greater than mild (ie, aortic stenosis: jet >3.0 meters per second [m/s], mean gradient >25 millimeters of mercury [mmHg], and aortic valve area <1.5 centimeters squared [cm^2]; mitral stenosis: mean gradient >5 mmHg and mitral valve area <1.5 cm^2)
EC7: Systolic pulmonary artery pressure (SPAP)  >40 mmHg ([OR] and/or tricuspid regurgitation [TR] jet velocity [OR] >2.9 m/s) In cases where an actual SPAP value is not measurable due to lack of adequate TR jet, the pulmonary flow acceleration time measured at the right ventricular outflow tract (RVOTAT) will be used to assess eligibility. Participants with a RVOTAT =100 milliseconds (msec) will be excluded, suggesting an elevated mean SPAP; eligibility for the those participants with RVOTAT between 100 and 120 msec will be determined based on combined assessment of the TR jet, septal motion, and right ventricular size.
EC11: Clinically significant pericardial effusion (eg, moderate or larger [OR] or with hemodynamic compromise)
EC12: Significant renal [OR] or hepatic disease as evidenced by a serum creatinine [OR] greater than 1.5× upper limit of normal (ULN), serum transaminases [OR] greater than 3× ULN, or total bilirubin [AND] greater than 1.5× ULN in [NOT] absence of Gilbert's syndrome
EC13: Any suicidal ideation [AND] with intent with [OR] or without a plan, at the time of [OR] or within 6 months of Screening, as indicated by answering "Yes" to questions 4 [OR] or 5 on the Suicidal Ideation section of the Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS)
EC14: Any suicidal behavior [AND] in the past based on the C-SSRS
EC15: Any history of anorexia [OR] or bulimia [OR] within 2 years before Screening, Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder [OR], any Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, 5th Edition depressive disorder [OR], bipolar disorder [OR], or schizophrenia
EC16: Known secondary causes (genetic [OR], endocrine [OR], or metabolic) for obesity (eg, Prader-Willi syndrome [OR], Bardet Biedl syndrome [OR], Down's Syndrome [OR], untreated hypothyroidism [OR], Cushing's syndrome [OR], daily systemic corticosteroid [OR] exposure for longer than 30 days, history of significant exposure to corticosteroids [AND] for chronic illness during the past year; inhaled steroids will be allowed)
EC17: Use of other products intended for weight loss including prescription [OR] drugs, over-the-counter (OTC) [OR] drugs, and herbal preparations within 1 month before Screening
EC26: dextromethorphan in any form (eg, OTC cold medicines)
EC30: antiseizure medications including valproic acid [OR], zonisamide [OR], topiramate [OR], and lamotrigine
EC31: oral steroids ([NOT] topical and inhaled steroids are acceptable)
EC32: stimulant medications (eg, Ritalin [OR], Concerta [OR], Biphetamine [OR], and Dexedrine)
EC34: Use of drugs known to increase the risk for cardiac valvulopathy within 6 months before Screening, including but not limited to pergolide [OR], ergotamine [OR], methysergide [OR], and cabergoline
EC35: History [OR] or evidence of clinically significant disease (eg, malignancy [OR]; cardiac [OR], respiratory [OR], gastrointestinal [OR], renal [OR], or psychiatric disease) [NOT] other than prediabetes (impaired fasting glucose [OR] or impaired glucose tolerance), type 2 diabetes treated with oral anti-diabetic agents ([NOT] excluding sulfonylurea) [OR] or non-insulin injectable antidiabetic agents [OR], obstructive sleep apnea [OR], dyslipidemia [OR], and nonalcoholic fatty liver disease
EC36: Use of Belviq XR  within 6 months before Screening [OR] or hypersensitivity [AND] to Belviq XR or any of the excipients
EC37: Significant change in diet or level of physical activity [OR] within 1 month before dosing or change in weight of more than 5 kg within 3 months before Screening
EC38: Any use of a very-low-calorie (<1000 calories/day) weight loss diet within 6 months before Screening
EC39: History of alcohol [OR] or drug dependence [OR] or abuse
EC40: Recreational drug use within 2 years before Screening
EC41: Known to be human immunodeficiency virus positive
EC42: Known to have active viral hepatitis (B [OR] or C)
EC44: Unable to attend scheduled visits (eg, lack of transportation) [OR] or lack of a caregiver [OR]  or guardian to supervise study participation
EC45: Special needs participants who are unable to comprehend study-related instructions (eg, mild to profound mental retardation [intelligence quotient <70] [OR] , moderate to severe cognitive developmental delay [OR], pervasive development disorders [OR], autism)
EC46: Ongoing epilepsy [OR] or other seizure disorder [OR], or use of medications [AND] for a seizure disorder within 6 months of screening or any time between screening and randomization
EC47: Participants with a blood pressure in the 95th percentile or greater for age, sex, and height on 2 separate readings recorded on 2 separate days. Those participants who had uncontrolled hypertension at Screening can be rescreened more than 1 month after initiation or adjustment of antihypertensive therapy 1 time.
EC48: Currently enrolled in another clinical study [OR] or has used any investigational drug [OR] or device within 30 days before providing informed consent
EC49: Planned bariatric surgery  during the study [OR] or prior [AND] bariatric surgical procedures
EC50: Not suitable to participate in the study in the opinion of the investigator, including consideration of any existing physical, medical, or mental condition that prevents compliance with the protocol
EC51: Female participants who are breastfeeding [OR] or pregnant at Screening [OR] or Baseline (as documented by a positive beta-human chorionic gonadotropin test). A separate Baseline assessment [AND] is required if a negative screening pregnancy test was obtained more than 72 hours before the first dose of study drug.
EC52: Had unprotected sexual intercourse within 30 days before study entry and who do not agree to use a highly effective method of contraception (eg, total abstinence [OR], an intrauterine device [OR], a double-barrier method [such as condom plus diaphragm with spermicide] [OR], a contraceptive implant [OR], an oral contraceptive [OR], or have a vasectomized [AND] partner [AND] with confirmed azoospermia) throughout the entire study period and for 28 days after study drug discontinuation
EC53: Are currently abstinent and do not agree to use a double-barrier method  (as described above) [OR] or [NOT] refrain from sexual activity during the study period and for 28 days after study drug discontinuation
EC54: Are using hormonal contraceptives, but are [NOT] not on a stable dose of the same hormonal contraceptive product for at least 4 weeks before dosing and who do not agree to use the same contraceptive during the study and for 28 days after study drug discontinuation (Note: All female participants will be considered to be of childbearing potential unless they have been sterilized surgically [ie, bilateral tubal ligation, total hysterectomy, or bilateral oophorectomy, all with surgery at least 1 month before dosing]).
